items.title: GDGoC SJBIT Organizer
items.role: Google Developer Groups on Campus — SJBIT
items.description: Leading the Google-backed campus developer community at SJBIT — organizing hands-on workshops, hackathons, and technical study jams, and managing a cross-functional core team that helps students bridge the gap between academic theory and real-world software engineering with Google Cloud, AI, and web/mobile technologies.

items.title: Operations Executive
items.description: Supporting the execution and delivery of esports tournaments and events by coordinating operations, logistics, cross-functional teams, and performance tracking to ensure seamless event delivery.

items.title: AZ Titan Admin
items.description: Managing community operations, onboarding, and campaign execution for AlphaZegus Titans Network — monitoring platform performance, leading new Titan activation, and driving engagement across forums and Discord.

items.title: Student Brand Ambassador
items.description: Promoting The Esports Club across my college, the city, and the gaming community through on-ground events, digital initiatives, and partnerships with student organizations, local venues, and gaming stores.
